about_the_role: StackForge runs the payments and reconciliation backend for fintech clients. Correctness, observability and clear data modelling matter more here than shipping fast.
responsibilities: Design, build and document REST APIs consumed by web and mobile clients.
Model relational database schemas and write efficient SQL queries with appropriate indexes.
Implement authentication and authorisation using JWT and OAuth2 flows.
Add structured logging, metrics and alerting so failures are detected before customers notice.
Write integration tests covering the critical transaction paths.
Review database migrations for backwards compatibility and data safety.
required_skills: Strong server-side Python, typically with FastAPI, Django or Flask.
Solid experience designing and versioning REST APIs.
Proficiency in SQL and relational Database Design including normalisation and indexing.
Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL in production.
Disciplined use of Git and pull-request based code review.
Experience writing automated Testing suites for server-side code.
preferred_skills: Experience with Docker and container-based deployment.
Familiarity with Redis for caching and rate limiting.
Exposure to Microservices architecture and service-to-service communication.
Experience with message queues such as RabbitMQ or Kafka for asynchronous processing.
Understanding of MongoDB or other document databases.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deploying to AWS.
Interest in System Design and scaling read-heavy workloads.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
Experience operating a service that real users depended on.
